author: Clld
quote: After 13 years, we just wanna jump into the escapism of GTA6. But theres just way too many mechanics that while optional, simply don’t belong in a GTA game, and are required for the best ending in GTA6. Lucia from the start is not a likable character. I don’t even want to date her, I want my Jason character to be single. But since I’m forced into a relationship with her, I can’t be single and mingle, or even have the very basic pleasure of hiring a hooker, which has been completely removed in this new adaptation of GTA. Which to me is a huge staple of the franchise, a lot of people got GTA because of that. You don’t even get into Leonida within the first couple of chapters, 15 to 20 hours in. We shouldn’t have to go through a slow burn slog to get to the action. The action should be there from the jump, especially after 13 years / building up the hype & anticipation. This game was not review bombed, it was too review hyped for sensationalism.
